comments.author: BIakeC
comments.body: What you can do is, when your aide reaches a combined level of 50, you can send them off to join the navy. Your lose the aide but your receive Aide experience books as reward to speed up the training of any new aide you hire. They give 30k exp in one selected field for each use. How many your receive depends on the aides levels and traits (the higher they are, the more your get).

comments.author: YoGolan
comments.body:
As regular navy receive once 2-3 Aide Voyager Record (gives 30k fame to aide when used).
Example:
You receive 2-3 AVR(battle) if your aide battle level is higher than trade and adv.--AVR(trade) if your aide trade level is higher than battle and adv. --AVR(adeventure) if your aide adventure level is higher than trade and battle.

In my personal case i sent several aides as regular navy and for that aide which trade , adv, battle levels was +30 i received AVR for 2or 3 classes.
Ofc higher are the levels , more AVR you will receive...

As Royal navy i heard can receive monthly some items.Like you imagine maybe 1AVR and some RIBS or RDemands.. idk.. some consumables .. now you can computing if worth to "dismis" 50/50/50 100 all traits aide.
GL

comments.author: Blake.C
comments.body:
Only one inherited skill can be available at once; selecting another skill when sending another aide to join the Royal Fleet will result in the previous skill being overwritten.

Not all skills can be inherited. Im afraid I dont know all of them except for some.

-Shot-defenses cant be inherited
-Ottoman aides cannot inherit Alcohol trading or Wining and Dining
-Aide cannot have both Cat breeding and fire prevention skill
-To inherit alchemy skill, aide must have Handicrafts and Arabic or Turkish language

comments.author: Edgedemon
comments.body:
you miss read "Only one inherited skill can be available at once", you can:

get one skill, inherit in whoever you want to have it.
send another aide and get another skill available for inheritance.

at this point you can no longer inherit the first skill in new aides but the previously inherited remain.

so yeah with more effort than sanity would recommend you can do you original plan
